block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Master Root Data Manifest & Continental System Orchestrator
purpose_and_intent: Serves as the cognitive root and architectural master catalog for
all externalized JSON data configurations across Tenebris and Lux.
Eliminates hardcoded values in compiled C11 binaries by organizing
data into 5 operational domains matching simulation data movement.

where_the_data_lives.topology: Layered Dual Data Taxonomy (engine/config/ mechanical profiles & game/data/ RPG lore)

what_the_data_enables: Decoupled headless deterministic TRPG simulation execution
Zero dynamic heap allocations in Layer 0 Core and Layer 1 Sim
Deterministic 4-posture combat stance finite state machine
Dynamic data pathfinding across workspace and build sandboxes
Dual-frontend parity between terminal CLI and native X11 GUI
Authentic project canon centered on The Dark Lord Usuru
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocation (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP) in Layer 0 and 1
All registered paths resolvable via fs_resolve_data_path()
Root directory hygiene: zero lingering caches or runtime logs
Deterministic stance machine with bounded resonance and moral sway

pre_conditions.filesystem_access: Read access to game/data/ root directory
pre_conditions.presentation_display: X11 Display server with CLI fallback

description: Data movement follows an operational baton-passing pipeline:
1. System initializes math bounds, clocks, and diagnostics.
2. World loads geography, provinces, and discrete grid topologies.
3. Entities populates character rosters, class growths, and bestiary.
4. Mechanics evaluates formations, ZOC, combat stances, and items.
5. Presentation projects simulation state into audio and viewports.

domains.title: Standalone Engine Configuration & Diagnostics
what_it_enables: Zero-heap bounded math clamping and safe division guards
60 FPS and 120 FPS high-refresh frame budgets and monotonic clocks
Safe string buffer sizing and canonical command tokens
Categorized static ring buffer telemetry and log rotation
Interactive 64-snapshot time-travel rewind and FNV-1a hashing

domains.title: World Domain: Continental Topology & Battlefields
what_it_enables: Continental realm node graphs and provincial travel vigor costs
Discrete 2D Cartesian tactical grids (32x32 to 64x64 cells)
Terrain friction rates, defensive cover, and line-of-sight bounds
Planar rift node placements and nocturnal astral gateways

domains.title: Entities Domain: Character Roster & Class Growths
what_it_enables: Protagonist state models (Elijah, Katrina, Custom Bearer)
Companions (Angela, Sebastien) and adversary bestiary (Dark Lord)
Three-tier class growth curves (Basic, Upgraded, Advanced)
NPC combatant archetypes and elemental summons (Fire, Pixie, Wind)

domains.title: Mechanics Domain: Simulation Rules, Tactics & Campaign
what_it_enables: 8-slot squad formation matrices with localized stat modifiers
Zone-of-Control (ZOC) kinetic perimeter and movement pinning
Deterministic 4-posture combat stance FSM and damage formulas
Twin Relics resonance (Shield of Lux and Sword of Tenebris)
5-route campaign ending matrix and moral sway inertia
Zero-heap command dispatcher and domain router

domains.title: Presentation Domain: Desktop Viewports, Audio & Visuals
what_it_enables: X11 double-buffered 2.5D diamond isometric viewport renderer
Responsive HUD gauge layouts and TrueType high-DPI font scaling
4-channel audio bus mixer with diegetic SFX and orchestral BGM
24-bit and 32-bit hardware color palettes for biomes and relics
32x32 character sprite sheets, terrain tilesets, and animations

verification_tripwires.name: ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP
verification_tripwires.rule: Zero dynamic heap allocations in Layer 0/1 data parsing

verification_tripwires.name: DYNAMIC_RESOLVABILITY
verification_tripwires.rule: All manifest paths resolvable via fs_resolve_data_path

verification_tripwires.name: COORDINATE_BOUNDEDNESS
verification_tripwires.rule: Discrete grid dimensions clamped within [0, 64) x [0, 64)

verification_tripwires.name: FRICTION_SAFETY
verification_tripwires.rule: Terrain movement friction must be strictly >= 1.0

verification_tripwires.name: COLLISION_INDEPENDENCE
verification_tripwires.rule: Hostile units cannot occupy identical grid coordinates

verification_tripwires.name: ROOT_HYGIENE
verification_tripwires.rule: Zero ephemeral build caches or logs outside build/
